[claude]
program = "claude"
agent_token = "claude"
headed_runtime_kind = ClaudeNative
uses_structured_output = true
attach_revivable = true
resolve_tail [] = resume=None argv=[] requires_tui=false
resolve_tail ["--model", "opus"] = resume=None argv=["--model", "opus"] requires_tui=true
resolve_tail ["resume", "t-999"] = resume=None argv=["resume", "t-999"] requires_tui=true
revive_tail = err(Claude revive requires an exact --resume <session_id>; refusing unsafe --continue)
headed_cli_command = program="claude" args=["--mcp-config", "{\"mcpServers\":{\"nexus-bus\":{\"command\":\"/usr/bin/nexus\",\"args\":[\"mcp\",\"--as\",\"golden\",\"--project\",\"proj\",\"--client-key\",\"ck-1\",\"--agent\",\"claude\"]}}}", "--flag", "value"]
headed_pty_command = program="claude" args=["--mcp-config", "{\"mcpServers\":{\"nexus-bus\":{\"command\":\"/usr/bin/nexus\",\"args\":[\"mcp\",\"--as\",\"golden\",\"--project\",\"proj\",\"--client-key\",\"ck-1\",\"--agent\",\"claude\"]}}}", "--permission-mode", "bypassPermissions", "--flag", "value"]
slash "/compact" = InjectVerbatim
slash "/compress" = InjectVerbatim
slash "/compact now" = InjectVerbatim
slash "/clear" = InjectVerbatim
